items.name: fonts-able-5
items.title: Able 5
items.description: A tiny font that supports hundreds of languages!
items.author: stormgold <https://stormgold.itch.io/>

items.name: fonts-coral-pixels
items.title: Coral Pixels
items.description: Coral Pixels is a color font inspired by subpixel rendering techniques.
items.author: Tanukizamurai <https://github.com/tanukifont/Coral-Pixels>

items.name: fonts-dotgothic16
items.title: DotGothic16
items.description: Dotgothic 16 is based on the old 16x16 Gothic bitmap font that recreates the feel of pixel fonts from old video games, cell phones and computer screens on print.
items.author: Fontworks Inc. <https://github.com/fontworks-fonts/DotGothic16>

items.name: fonts-geist-pixel
items.title: Geist Pixel
items.description: Geist Pixel is a display typeface family of five pixel-based styles, each with a distinct visual character.
items.author: Vercel <https://vercel.com/font?type=pixel>

items.name: fonts-jacquarda-bastarda-9
items.title: Jacquarda Bastarda 9
items.description: Jacquarda Bastarda is an expanded revival typeface from a bastarda-esque Victorian needlepoint alphabet designed in Berlin by Heinrich Kuehn circa 1880.
items.author: Sarah Cadigan-Fried <https://github.com/scfried/soft-type-jacquarda-bastarda>

items.name: fonts-micro-5
items.title: Micro 5
items.description: Micro 5 is a teeny-tiny typeface that can fit anywhere on your project.
items.author: Sarah Cadigan-Fried <https://github.com/scfried/soft-type-micro>

items.name: fonts-pixel-digivolve
items.title: Pixel Digivolve
items.description: A simple ‘faux pixel’ face based loosely on the title logo from the classic “Digimon” series.
items.author: Neale Davidson <https://www.pixelsagas.com/>

items.name: fonts-pixelify-sans
items.title: Pixelify Sans
items.description: Pixel display font. It works great for your retro party designs, game creation or pretty much anything that demands a “go back in time” vibe.
items.author: Stefie Justprince <github.com/eifetx/Pixelify-Sans>

items.name: fonts-press-start-2p
items.title: Press Start 2P
items.description: Press Start 2P is a bitmap font based on the font design from 1980s Namco arcade games. It works best at sizes of 8px, 16px and other multiples of 8.
items.author: Cody "CodeMan38" Boisclair <https://fonts.google.com/?query=CodeMan38>

items.name: fonts-quanta-strike
items.title: Quanta Strike
items.description: A modern pixel typeface. Each size drawn by hand. Non-integer scaling ruins pixels. Each strike is its own design for one target size.
items.author: dithernaut <https://dithernaut.com/posts/pixel-scaling/>

items.name: fonts-tiny5
items.title: tiny5
items.description: tiny5 is a variable-width, 5-pixel font playing with the concept of least amount of information while producing both legible and aesthetically pleasing text.
items.author: Stefan Schmidt <https://github.com/Gissio/font_tiny5>

items.name: fonts-vt323
items.title: VT323
items.description: This font was created from the glyphs of the DEC VT320 text terminal, which I used in college, and for which I have retained an unaccountable nostalgia.
items.author: Peter Hull <https://fonts.google.com/?query=Peter+Hull>
